examples: Doctors warn that childhood obesity has increased significantly over the past two decades.
پزشکان هشدار می‌دهند که چاقی مفرط در کودکان در دو دهه گذشته به‌طور قابل توجهی افزایش یافته است.
A diet high in sugar and fat is strongly linked to obesity.
رژیم غذایی پرشکر و پرچرب به‌شدت با چاقی مفرط در ارتباط است.
The clinic offers a special program for patients struggling with obesity.
این کلینیک برنامه ویژه‌ای برای بیمارانی که با چاقی مفرط دست‌وپنجه نرم می‌کنند ارائه می‌دهد.
miniContext: Obesity is a medical condition involving an excessive amount of body fat that increases health risks. Public health campaigns often focus on preventing obesity through better diet and more physical activity. Researchers continue to study how genetics and lifestyle both contribute to obesity.

examples: The flu epidemic forced several schools in the city to close for two weeks.
همه‌گیری آنفولانزا چند مدرسه در شهر را مجبور کرد دو هفته تعطیل شوند.
Health officials worked around the clock to contain the epidemic before it spread further.
مقامات بهداشتی شبانه‌روز کار کردند تا همه‌گیری را قبل از گسترش بیشتر مهار کنند.
Some experts now describe loneliness among the elderly as a quiet epidemic.
برخی کارشناسان اکنون تنهایی در سالمندان را یک همه‌گیری خاموش توصیف می‌کنند.
miniContext: An epidemic is a sudden widespread outbreak of a disease within a particular region or population. Vaccination campaigns have successfully stopped several epidemics before they could spread across borders. The documentary traces how a small outbreak grew into a nationwide epidemic within months.

examples: After hurting his back at work, he decided to see a chiropractor for treatment.
بعد از اینکه کمرش را در محل کار صدمه زد، تصمیم گرفت برای درمان به یک متخصص درمان دستی ستون فقرات مراجعه کند.
The chiropractor gently adjusted her spine to relieve the chronic pain.
متخصص درمان دستی ستون فقرات به‌آرامی ستون فقرات او را تنظیم کرد تا درد مزمن کاهش یابد.
Many athletes visit a chiropractor regularly to maintain flexibility and prevent injuries.
بسیاری از ورزشکاران به‌طور منظم به یک متخصص درمان دستی ستون فقرات مراجعه می‌کنند تا انعطاف‌پذیری خود را حفظ کنند و از آسیب جلوگیری کنند.
miniContext: A chiropractor is a healthcare professional who treats problems of the spine and joints through manual adjustment. People with persistent back pain often try a chiropractor before considering surgery. Her chiropractor recommended a combination of stretching exercises and regular adjustments to ease the discomfort.

examples: Open the windows to ventilate the room after painting the walls.
پنجره‌ها را باز کن تا بعد از رنگ‌کردن دیوارها، اتاق را تهویه کنی.
The factory installed large fans to ventilate the workshop and remove the fumes.
کارخانه پنکه‌های بزرگی نصب کرد تا کارگاه را تهویه کند و دودها را خارج کند.
Hospitals must ventilate operating rooms carefully to reduce the risk of infection.
بیمارستان‌ها باید اتاق‌های عمل را با دقت تهویه کنند تا خطر عفونت کاهش یابد.
miniContext: To ventilate a space means to let fresh air circulate through it, usually to remove heat, smoke, or odors. Builders are required to ventilate bathrooms properly to prevent mold from growing on the walls. Before using strong cleaning chemicals, it is important to ventilate the area by opening a window or door.

examples: Students must pass both a written test and an oral exam to finish the course.
دانش‌آموزان باید هم یک آزمون کتبی و هم یک آزمون شفاهی را برای پایان دوره قبول شوند.
The dentist recommended better oral hygiene to prevent further tooth decay.
دندان‌پزشک برای پیشگیری از پوسیدگی بیشتر دندان، بهداشت دهانی بهتر را توصیه کرد.
Before signing the contract, the two companies had already reached an oral agreement.
قبل از امضای قرارداد، آن دو شرکت قبلاً به یک توافق شفاهی رسیده بودند.
miniContext: Oral refers to anything related to the mouth, or more broadly, to something spoken rather than written. Many cultures preserved their history for centuries through oral storytelling before writing became common. The doctor prescribed an oral medication that patients take by mouth twice a day.

examples: Scientists use a powerful microscope to magnify cells so they can study their structure.
دانشمندان از یک میکروسکوپ قدرتمند برای بزرگ‌نمایی سلول‌ها استفاده می‌کنند تا ساختارشان را بررسی کنند.
A small mistake in the early stages of a project can magnify into a major problem later.
یک اشتباه کوچک در مراحل اولیه یک پروژه می‌تواند بعداً به یک مشکل بزرگ بدل شود.
The lens on his glasses was designed to magnify fine print on medicine labels.
عدسی عینک او طوری طراحی شده بود که متن ریز روی برچسب داروها را بزرگ‌نمایی کند.
miniContext: To magnify something means to make it appear larger, or to make its effect stronger. Photographers sometimes use a special lens to magnify distant subjects without moving closer. Stress at work can magnify small disagreements at home into much bigger arguments.

examples: A fallen tree became an unexpected obstacle on the hiking trail.
یک درخت افتاده به‌طور غیرمنتظره‌ای به مانعی در مسیر پیاده‌روی تبدیل شد.
Lack of funding remains the biggest obstacle to finishing the research project.
کمبود بودجه همچنان بزرگ‌ترین مانع برای تکمیل پروژه تحقیقاتی است.
She refused to let her disability become an obstacle to pursuing her dream career.
او اجازه نداد ناتوانی‌اش به مانعی برای دنبال کردن شغل رویایی‌اش تبدیل شود.
miniContext: An obstacle is anything that blocks progress or makes it harder to reach a goal. Every runner in the race had to climb over several obstacles built along the course. Language can be a serious obstacle for immigrants trying to find stable employment in a new country.

examples: After forty years at the company, he retired with a comfortable pension.
بعد از چهل سال کار در شرکت، او با یک مستمری بازنشستگی راحت بازنشسته شد.
The government is considering raising the retirement age to protect the pension system.
دولت در نظر دارد سن بازنشستگی را افزایش دهد تا از سیستم مستمری محافظت کند.
Many workers worry that their pension will not be enough to cover living expenses later in life.
بسیاری از کارگران نگران هستند که مستمری‌شان کافی برای پوشش هزینه‌های زندگی در سنین بالاتر نباشد.
miniContext: A pension is a regular payment made to someone after they retire from work. Employers sometimes offer a pension plan as part of an employee's overall benefits package. She spent years calculating how much pension she would need to live comfortably after retiring.

examples: One more mistake could jeopardize the entire project and cost the company its biggest client.
یک اشتباه دیگر می‌تواند کل پروژه را به خطر بیندازد و بزرگ‌ترین مشتری شرکت را از دست بدهد.
Smoking can seriously jeopardize your health, even if you only do it occasionally.
سیگار کشیدن می‌تواند به‌طور جدی سلامتی‌تان را به خطر بیندازد، حتی اگر فقط گاهی این کار را بکنید.
The coach warned players that skipping practice would jeopardize their place on the team.
مربی به بازیکنان هشدار داد که غیبت از تمرین جایگاهشان در تیم را به خطر خواهد انداخت.
miniContext: To jeopardize something means to put it at serious risk of being damaged or lost. A single data leak can jeopardize a company's reputation that took years to build. Driving while tired can jeopardize not only your own safety but also the safety of others on the road.

examples: The test results came back negative, which relieved the whole family.
نتایج آزمایش منفی بود، که باعث آسودگی کل خانواده شد.
She tried to stay positive despite all the negative comments on her first video.
او با وجود تمام نظرات منفی روی اولین ویدیوی خود، سعی کرد مثبت بماند.
A negative balance in your account can result in extra bank fees.
موجودی منفی در حساب شما می‌تواند منجر به هزینه‌های بانکی اضافی شود.
miniContext: Negative describes something unfavorable, harmful, or lacking a positive quality, and it can apply to numbers, test results, or attitudes. Constant negative feedback at work can slowly damage an employee's confidence. Scientists were relieved when the sample tested negative for the contaminant.

examples: The municipal government announced new recycling rules for all city residents.
دولت شهری قوانین جدید بازیافت را برای تمام ساکنان شهر اعلام کرد.
Repairs to the municipal water system will cause temporary outages next week.
تعمیرات سیستم آب شهری هفته آینده باعث قطعی‌های موقت خواهد شد.
The new library was funded entirely through municipal taxes.
کتابخانه جدید کاملاً از طریق مالیات‌های شهری تأمین مالی شد.
miniContext: Municipal refers to matters related to the local government of a town or city. Residents can attend municipal council meetings to voice concerns about local issues. The municipal budget covers services like trash collection, street repair, and public parks.

examples: Clean drinking water is vital for preventing disease in crowded refugee camps.
آب آشامیدنی تمیز برای پیشگیری از بیماری در اردوگاه‌های پرازدحام پناهجویان حیاتی است.
Sleep plays a vital role in how well the brain recovers from daily stress.
خواب نقش حیاتی در میزان بهبود مغز از استرس روزانه ایفا می‌کند.
Getting early feedback from customers is vital to improving the final product.
دریافت بازخورد زودهنگام از مشتریان برای بهبود محصول نهایی حیاتی است.
miniContext: Vital describes something absolutely necessary or essential for success or survival. Doctors monitor a patient's vital signs, such as heart rate and blood pressure, throughout surgery. Trust between team members is vital if a project depends on close collaboration.
